quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #4
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 14

questions.question: What is the term for the amount of alcohol in your blood?

options.text: Implied consent (IC).
Blood alcohol concentration (BAC).
Rate of alcohol consumption (RAC).

questions.explanation: Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) measures the percentage of alcohol in your blood. A higher BAC means a person is more impaired.

questions.question: What should you do at a railroad crossing with lowered gates and flashing lights?

options.text: Drive around the crossing gates if you can't see a train.
Come to a complete stop well behind the gates, wait for the tracks to clear, and proceed once the gates are lifted.
Slow down and drive around the gates.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop well behind the gates, wait for the tracks to clear, and proceed once the gates are lifted.
questions.explanation: You must stop at a railroad crossing when signs, warning lights, or flaggers alert you to a train. It is illegal to drive around lowered gates.

questions.question: Is it legal to drive while taking medication that impairs your driving?

options.text: Under no circumstances.
If you don't feel drowsy.
If it is prescribed by a physician.

questions.explanation: It is illegal to drive while impaired by any substance, including alcohol, prescription drugs, over-the-counter drugs, or illegal drugs.

questions.question: Is texting while driving legal?

options.text: Always legal, but not recommended.
Illegal.
A safe activity.
Legal, but only for non-probationary license holders.

questions.explanation: In New York State, drivers cannot use a cell phone to text or read messages while driving. Texting while driving can result in a fine of up to $450.

questions.question: Why is night driving more difficult than day driving?

options.text: Cars overheat more quickly at night.
Visibility is reduced in the dark.
It is more likely to be raining at night.
You are more likely to encounter a motorcycle at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: Visibility is reduced in the dark.
questions.explanation: At night, you cannot see as far ahead. Use your headlights and drive slowly enough to stop within the distance you can see.

questions.question: What does it mean when a school bus stops on the road with flashing red lights?

options.text: You may pass if no children are on the road.
You may not pass.
You may pass if you are facing the front of the bus.
You may pass if it is on the opposite side of a divided highway.

questions.explanation: When a school bus has flashing red lights, all traffic from any direction must stop at least 20 feet away. Do not drive until the lights stop flashing or the bus driver signals you to go. In New York State, you must stop even if the bus is on the opposite side of a divided highway.

questions.question: How does alcohol affect your driving skills and judgment?

options.text: It helps driving skills but harms your judgement.
It harms both driving skills and judgement.
It has no effect on either driving skills or judgement.
It has no effect on judgement but it harms driving skills.

questions.correctAnswerText: It harms both driving skills and judgement.
questions.explanation: Alcohol slows your reaction time and makes it hard to see clearly. It also affects your judgment of speed and distance, reduces your caution, and makes you more likely to take risks.

questions.question: What type of sign is diamond-shaped?

options.text: Road hazard sign.
Interstate route sign.
School crossing sign.
Speed limit sign.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and usually yellow. In work areas, they may be orange. These signs warn you of hazards ahead or areas with special rules.

questions.question: How serious is the problem of drinking and driving?

options.text: A minor traffic safety problem.
A serious traffic safety problem.
Safe if you have only had a few drinks.
Only dangerous to the driver who drinks.

questions.explanation: Driving while impaired is a serious safety problem. You cannot drive safely after drinking alcohol or using drugs. Impaired driving endangers both you and others on the road.

questions.question: In New York State, who must wear seat belts in moving vehicles?

options.text: Only drivers
Only passengers
Drivers and all passengers
Only children

questions.explanation: In New York State, all adults must wear seat belts in moving vehicles. All children must use seat belts, booster seats, or child restraints. Fines of up to $100 apply for not wearing seat belts.

questions.question: After you finish parallel parking between two cars on a level street, what should you do?

options.text: Leave your front wheels turned toward the curb.
Make sure your car almost touches the car behind you.
Move as far forward in the space as possible.
Straighten your front wheels and leave room between cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: Straighten your front wheels and leave room between cars.
questions.explanation: After parallel parking, straighten your wheels and move forward to create space. This lets other cars move safely.

questions.question: If you have an argument with someone and feel angry, what should you do?

options.text: Play loud radio while driving so you won't think about the argument.
Take a few minutes to calm down before driving.
Drive on the interstate to let off steam.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down before driving.
questions.explanation: Strong emotions make driving unsafe. If you are angry, excited, scared, worried, or sad, wait until you feel calm before you drive. You need to focus on the road, not on what upset you.

questions.question: When you see a bicyclist ahead, you should:

options.text: Speed up to pass them.
Keep driving normally.
Swerve into the other lane.
Be very careful.

questions.explanation: Slow down when passing a bicyclist. The wind from your car can knock them off balance.

questions.question: A driver who goes much slower than the speed limit:

options.text: Is always a very safe driver.
Always has the right-of-way.
Should not let other cars pass.
May cause a dangerous situation.

questions.explanation: Driving much slower than other traffic can be unsafe. If traffic backs up behind you on a two-lane road, pull over and let cars pass. Only drive well below the speed limit when road conditions require it.

questions.question: Can you drive around or under a railroad gate that is going up or down?

options.text: Yes, if a train is not too close.
Yes, if your car will not damage the gate.
Yes, if you look both ways first.
No, never.

questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, flashing red lights, lowered gates, and bells mean you must stop completely. Do not cross the tracks until the lights and bells stop and the gates are fully up. Never drive around or under a moving gate.

questions.question: This orange sign means:

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.
No passing zone.
Construction work ahead.

questions.explanation: Orange warning signs tell you that road work is coming. Stay alert for temporary traffic control signs in work zones.

questions.question: What does this chevron sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the road.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show sharp curves. The arrow points in the direction of the curve. You may see several chevron signs through a curve.

questions.question: What should you do before you turn?

options.text: Use your turn signal.
Turn the steering wheel.
Speed up.
Change lanes.

questions.explanation: Turn on your signal 3 to 4 seconds before you turn. This tells other drivers what you plan to do.

questions.question: You are driving on a divided highway with multiple lanes. You see or hear an emergency vehicle coming. What should you do?

options.text: Ignore it if other lanes are open for the emergency vehicle.
Stop as fast as you can.
Slow down, move out of the way, and stop.
Speed up to get out of the way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, move out of the way, and stop.
questions.explanation: When you hear a siren or see flashing lights, slow down, move to the side to clear a path, and stop. Do not try to outrun the emergency vehicle.

questions.question: What color are warning signs that show upcoming hazards?

options.text: Black letters on a white background
Black letters on a yellow background
White letters on a blue background
White letters on a green background

questions.correctAnswerText: Black letters on a yellow background
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. Work zone signs are orange with black letters or symbols.
